doc: Check and preview pixel effects through the real GPU renderer, run the render contract's conformance suite on this machine's device, describe the device, look at a glTF model beside another renderer's picture of it.

tools.name: effect.check
tools.description: Read each effect file, compile its shader for the device formats and register it: its parameters, or every problem at file, line and column

tools.name: effect.preview
tools.description: Draw an effect with the GPU renderer over a picture (a test card when none), before | after side by side, as PNG

file.description: a file or directory path: the effect file

out.description: a file or directory path: the PNG written

image.description: a file or directory path: a PNG to apply it to

param.description: NAME=VALUE overrides, clamped to each parameter's range

tools.name: conformance.run
tools.description: The render contract's conformance suite on this machine's device: each case against the CPU reference within its tolerance; failing pictures kept

report.description: a file or directory path: write the full *.cts.omui.json report here

tools.name: model.look
tools.description: Draw a glTF model with the CPU reference as a viewer of products frames it, lit by an HDR picture of the surroundings, as PNG; say how far it is from another renderer's picture of the same (the render-fidelity suite's measure) and from the light followed way by way

model.description: a file or directory path: a .gltf or .glb

out.description: a file or directory path: the PNG written: nothing where the model is not

light.description: a file or directory path: a Radiance .hdr of the surroundings

orbit.description: THETA,PHI,RADIUS: degrees about the way up from +z, degrees down from it, how far

upright.description: the angle of view up and down, degrees

samples.description: N by N samples a pixel, 1 to 4

golden.description: a file or directory path: another renderer's PNG of the same size to stand beside

follow.description: rays a pixel for the light followed way by way, a quarter as large each way

tools.name: device.describe
tools.description: The GPU device: backend, name, whether it is software, shader formats, limits
